## Start here

If you're new to the course, read the [syllabus](syllabus.qmd) first, then
check the [schedule](schedule.qmd) for the next thing due. Every lesson page
carries its own code, so you can follow along in R while you read rather than
after.

## What you'll need

You'll want [R](https://cran.r-project.org) and
[RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) installed before the
first lesson. Both are free, and RStudio bundles everything else this site
relies on. Every code block on this site can be copied straight into the
console with the button in its top-right corner.

## How this site works

These pages are built from the same repository the course staff edits, so a
correction pushed in the morning is live by the afternoon. If you spot an
error, the **Edit this page** link in the footer of any page will take you
straight to the source.
